About Me

Interdisciplinary background spanning STEM, illustration, and creative media (game design), combining structured logical thinking with visual creativity. Full-process experience in brand visual design, promotional material production, pixel art animation, and IP brand promotion. Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite; skilled in leveraging AI tools such as Midjourney and Trae to achieve rapid design iteration from concept to physical delivery. Overseas education background with bilingual (Chinese/English) design capabilities and cross-cultural collaboration experience.
